//: Copy to config.json and edit. Or skip it: npm start -- "D:\Series" "E:\More"
//subtitleRoots: Extra folders scanned for subtitle files only. Useful when subs live somewhere else (a Downloads folder) instead of next to the videos.
//seriesAliases: Groups of names that mean the same show. Needed when your videos and your subtitles use different titles for the same series.
//preferredAudioLang: ISO-639-2 code of the audio track to auto-select when a file has several. Keeps you on the original language instead of a dub. Empty string = use the file's default track.
//assumeHevcSupport: Set true if your browser plays HEVC/H.265 (Edge on Windows with the HEVC Video Extension does). Saves a slow transcode. If video stays black, set it back to false.
